data.title: 圣女贞德 · 圣泉湿身的白蕾丝独奏
data.description: 远离战火的古老岩窟圣泉之中，清泉自岩缝潺潺涌出，泛着神圣澄澈的幽蓝光泽。贞德解下厚重的银白胸甲，仅着一身洁白的刺绣蕾丝吊带衬裙浸入泉中。清泉将薄薄的白蕾丝彻底湿透，紧密贴合着她匀称柔美的身躯与神圣曲线。金色的麻花辫被打湿贴在颈侧，她双手合十按在胸前，紫眸清澈纯洁，带着无暇的虔诚与温情凝视着守护身旁的你。
data.action: 浸入清澈圣泉岩洞中，湿水白蕾丝小衣贴身，双手合十按胸，紫眸虔诚圣洁凝望观众
data.lighting: 圣泉水底微光与洞窟上方透下的神圣天光
data.camera: from front, facing viewer, looking directly at viewer, eye contact, cowboy shot, eye level
data.mood: 圣女的纯洁圣美与澄澈动人
data.promptProse: Jeanne sits at the edge of the sacred spring facing the viewer, wearing a delicate white lace camisole that clings translucently to her wet skin, revealing her delicate collarbone, cleavage, and shoulders beaded with water droplets; heavenly sunbeams filter through chapel arches onto her serene expression.
data.animaCaption: Facing the viewer at the sacred spring, her wet translucent white lace camisole reveals her delicate collarbone and cleavage in the holy sunlight.
